name: django-dynamic-user-repo
description: Workspace root — hoists frontend/'s dependencies to a node_modules directory that is an ancestor of both frontend/ and tests/frontend/, mirroring ../appkit's and ../cleanup_app's own workspace roots. playground/frontend joins as a second member in Phase 8 (docs/APP-DESIGN.md §11.2/§12) so it and frontend/ (the SDK under test) share ONE physical copy of react/@tanstack/react-query/@hjtdev/appkit — the duplicate-copy hazard §12 documents. Not published; carries no dependencies of its own.
